slides.title: qTrace is onboard
slides.text: qTrace enables you to forge your workflow on the flow. It tracks each annotation, detection, classifier & script into a unique .qtrace file that you can store, review, replay on another image & share with another person.

slides.title: Your panel at hand
slides.text: The first thing you see in QuPath is this bar, floating over the viewer. Each button is one tool of qTrace; the same button lights up in your panel while we talk about it.

buttons.title: Stamp
buttons.text: Put a milestone into your workflow

buttons.title: Upload
buttons.text: Upload your qtrace into your workspace

buttons.title: Replay
buttons.text: Run your trace onto any images

slides.title: Checking your connection
slides.text: qTrace needs to download its modules from GitHub to proceed with the installation.

slides.title: Sign in to qtrace.ca
slides.text: An account on qtrace.ca gives you one workspace for all your projects, lets you search your traces and share them with your colleagues. You can replay them from any workstation, without worrying about dependency files. You need it to upload your records.

actions.label: Sign in or create an account

slides.title: Finish in your browser
slides.text: qtrace.ca opened in your browser: create your account or sign in, follow the steps shown there, then click “Authorize QuPath”. QuPath is connected as soon as you do.

account.title: You are signed in
account.text: You can upload, share and replay your records right away. They are not certified: an identity certificate, obtained from qtrace.ca, is what certifies the records you sign.

slides.title: Installing your modules
slides.text: Your certificate is saved. qTrace downloads the modules it gives you, then asks you to restart QuPath once.

account.title: Installing your modules
account.text: Records you upload are not certified. qTrace downloads the modules your account includes, then asks you to restart QuPath once.

slides.title: qTrace is on board
slides.text: qTrace already records your work in QuPath: open a project and work as usual. Whenever you want your results signed with your certified identity, sign in from Extensions > QTrace > Help > Getting started.
